title: [finding] create-objectstack runtime-image test's satisfiesCaret helper cannot parse a prerelease range — it goes red on any cut-rc version pass (e.g. 18.0.0-rc.N)
body:
## What happens

The scaffolder writes `^<own version>` for `@objectstack/cli`. On a `cut-rc.yml` version pass in pre mode, the package version becomes e.g. `18.0.0-rc.1`, so the scaffolded range is `^18.0.0-rc.1`.

The test-local helper in `packages/create-objectstack/src/runtime-image.test.ts` accepts only a plain `^X.Y.Z`:

```ts
function satisfiesCaret(range: string, version: string): boolean {
  const r = /^\^(\d+)\.(\d+)\.(\d+)$/.exec(range);
  const v = /^(\d+)\.(\d+)\.(\d+)/.exec(version);
  if (!r || !v) return false;
  ...
```

The regex rejects `^18.0.0-rc.1`, so the helper returns `false` for every version. The agreement assertion then fails on the RC version PR. The fixture precondition that the #20560 fix adds fails there too. Under semver, `18.1.2` does satisfy `^18.0.0-rc.1`, so the verdict is wrong.

## Evidence

The behaviour is read from the helper source on `main` and on #20565's head. It has not been run against an RC tree. The helper predates #20565: the old `${major}.4.2` literal reaches the same helper.

This is the same class as #20562: a test that is sound only at the train's current version shape, and is exercised only after the version pass.

## Fix

Make the helper accept an optional prerelease tail on the range's floor, using semver caret semantics for a prerelease floor: same major, and `>=` the floor. A later release version satisfies the range. Alternatively, use the `semver` package if it is already a devDependency. Add a unit case for `^18.0.0-rc.1` so the next RC cut does not find this on the release PR.
